items.text: Schwab reports $13.33 trillion in client assets as of September 30, 2026.
items.definition: Client assets: The market value, as of the end of the reporting period, of all client assets in our custody, BDA balances, and proprietary products, which includes both cash and securities.

cells.reason: Client assets are disclosed in multiple periods but no advisor count is provided in these passages, so client assets per advisor is not directly disclosed; the item states client assets as the closest disclosed (numerator) figure.
